items.title_en: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
items.title_zh: 以色列对高度敏感的西岸定居点项目开放投标
items.desc_en: Israeli plans to build on the area east of Jerusalem - which would divide the occupied West Bank in two - have long been internationally condemned.
items.desc_zh: 以色列计划在耶路撒冷以东地区进行建设——这将把被占领的约旦河西岸一分为二——长期以来一直受到国际社会的谴责。

items.title_en: Trump touted a deal to avert new tariffs on Canada. Here's what we know so far
items.title_zh: 特朗普吹捧了一项避免对加拿大征收新关税的协议。这是迄今为止我们所知道的

items.desc_zh: 特朗普对价值约 200 亿美元的加拿大商品征收的新关税原定于周三生效，但被推迟了三天。

items.title_en: Board approves $19.9 billion plan to overhaul Washington Dulles airport
items.title_zh: 董事会批准耗资 199 亿美元改造华盛顿杜勒斯机场的计划
items.desc_en: The $6.2 billion reconstruction of the main terminal at the primary international airport serving the D.C. region is set to begin in late 2027.
items.desc_zh: 耗资 62 亿美元对服务于华盛顿特区的主要国际机场主航站楼进行的重建将于 2027 年底开始。

items.title_en: Yields are driving the stock market right now. These are the stocks with the most at stake
items.title_zh: 目前，收益率正在推动股市。这些是最危险的股票
items.desc_en: CNBC Pro screened the S&P 1500 to list stocks that will benefit most if yields pullback
items.desc_zh: CNBC Pro 筛选了标准普尔 1500 指数，列出了收益率回调时最受益的股票

items.title_en: U.S. warns Siemens devices can be hacked amid fears Iran is breaching water plants
items.title_zh: 美国警告西门子设备可能遭到黑客攻击，担心伊朗破坏水厂
items.desc_en: The warning ‌comes as cyber incidents ⁠target U.S. water systems in attacks ​cybersecurity ‌experts suspect are linked to Iran.
items.desc_zh: 这一警告发出之际，网络安全专家怀疑针对美国供水系统的网络事件与伊朗有关。

items.title_en: 81,000 warning letters sent to crypto holders in HMRC tax crackdown
items.title_zh: 英国税务海关总署 (HMRC) 税收打击行动中，向加密货币持有者发送了 81,000 封警告信
items.desc_en: According to a Freedom of Information (FOI) request the number of letters sent has almost tripled since 2024.
items.desc_zh: 根据信息自由 (FOI) 要求，自 2024 年以来发送的信件数量几乎增加了两倍。

items.title_en: Two detained after French influencer's scorched body found in vineyard
items.title_zh: 法国影响者在葡萄园发现烧焦尸体后，两人被拘留
items.desc_en: Sonia Bellina's body was "abandoned" after "a murder of rare savagery", the family's lawyer says.
items.desc_zh: 索尼娅·贝利纳家人的律师表示，索尼娅·贝利纳的尸体在“罕见的野蛮谋杀”后被“遗弃”。

items.title_en: Cramer on Treasury buying: People want to preserve the stock rally ‘in the worst way’
items.title_zh: 克莱默谈国债购买：人们希望“以最糟糕的方式”维持股市上涨
items.desc_en: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said the Treasury’s expanded bond buybacks may provide near-term relief for markets, but the intervention underscores strain in the government debt market.
items.desc_zh: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，财政部扩大债券回购规模可能会在短期内缓解市场压力，但此举凸显了政府债务市场的压力。

items.title_en: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Moderna, Pilgrim's Pride, Target, gold miners & more

items.desc_en: These are the stocks posting the largest moves midday.
items.desc_zh: 这些是午盘涨幅最大的股票。

items.title_en: 'I was born in South Africa', says beauty queen facing legal bid to deport her
items.title_zh: 选美皇后面临合法驱逐，称“我出生在南非”
items.desc_en: Chidimma Adetshina is challenging efforts to have her deported from South Africa, which she says is her home.
items.desc_zh: Chidimma Adetshina 正在挑战将她驱逐出南非的努力，她说南非是她的家。

items.title_en: Trump administration can target Ethiopians for deportation
items.title_zh: 特朗普政府可以将埃塞俄比亚人驱逐出境
items.desc_en: A judge's ruling on Tuesday removed the last remaining block on Trump officials' efforts to cancel Temporary Protected Status for Ethiopians.
items.desc_zh: 法官周二的裁决消除了特朗普官员取消埃塞俄比亚人临时保护地位的最后障碍。

items.title_en: Marvell pops 6% on AI chip deal that lets Google buy up to $12.2 billion in shares
items.title_zh: Marvell 在 AI 芯片交易中股价上涨 6%，谷歌可购买高达 122 亿美元的股票
items.desc_en: Google and its competitors have been pursuing custom chips to improve efficiency and reduce reliance on Nvidia.
items.desc_zh: 谷歌及其竞争对手一直在寻求定制芯片，以提高效率并减少对英伟达的依赖。

items.title_en: Watch: SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast
items.title_zh: 观看：在圣诞岛海岸发现 SpaceX 火箭
items.desc_en: A Christmas Island resident was surprised to find the massive piece of debris floating off the coast.
items.desc_zh: 一名圣诞岛居民惊讶地发现这块巨大的碎片漂浮在海岸边。

items.title_en: Retail giant Target receives $1bn boost from tariff refunds
items.title_zh: 零售巨头塔吉特 (Target) 因关税退款获得 10 亿美元收益
items.desc_en: The US chain said it received a $994 million pre-tax reimbursement, which resulted in its second quarter operating income rising to $2.6bn.
items.desc_zh: 这家美国连锁店表示，它收到了 9.94 亿美元的税前报销，这导致其第二季度营业收入升至 26 亿美元。

items.title_en: Angélique Kidjo becomes first African musician with Hollywood Walk of Fame star
items.title_zh: 安吉丽克·基乔 (Angélique Kidjo) 成为首位入选好莱坞星光大道的非洲音乐家
items.desc_en: Without Africans, no music is possible on this planet, says the 66-year-old musical icon from Benin.
items.desc_zh: 这位来自贝宁的 66 岁音乐偶像表示，如果没有非洲人，这个星球上就不可能有音乐。

items.title_en: Carvana shares are under pressure this week as Mark Walter probe fuels investor jitters
items.title_zh: 由于马克·沃尔特 (Mark Walter) 调查加剧了投资者的不安，卡瓦纳 (Carvana) 股价本周面临压力
items.desc_en: The scrutiny raised questions about what could happen to Walter's Carvana position if fallout from the investigation pressures him to raise cash.
items.desc_zh: 此次审查引发了人们的疑问：如果调查的后果迫使沃尔特筹集现金，他的卡瓦纳职位可能会发生什么。

items.title_en: Nvidia plays matchmaker in Nordics, sources tell CNBC, as AI data center deals boom in region
items.title_zh: 消息人士告诉 CNBC，随着该地区人工智能数据中心交易的蓬勃发展，英伟达在北欧扮演了媒人的角色
items.desc_en: Nvidia is trying to connect GPU customers with Nordic data-center operators as cheap power and available land fuel the region’s AI infrastructure boom.
items.desc_zh: Nvidia 正试图将 GPU 客户与北欧数据中心运营商联系起来，因为廉价的电力和可用的土地推动了该地区人工智能基础设施的繁荣。

items.title_en: Monzo down as some users unable to make card payments or transfers
items.title_zh: 由于一些用户无法进行卡支付或转账，Monzo 瘫痪
items.desc_en: The digital bank said it was "rolling out a fix and moving quickly" to get the service working again
items.desc_zh: 这家数字银行表示正在“推出修复程序并迅速采取行动”以使服务重新运行

items.title_en: Hedge funds are about to jump into prediction markets in a big way
items.title_zh: 对冲基金即将大举进军预测市场
items.desc_en: Cantor Fitzgerald will be one of the first investment firms providing its clients institutional trading on prediction market platform Kalshi.
items.desc_zh: Cantor Fitzgerald 将成为首批在预测市场平台 Kalshi 上为客户提供机构交易的投资公司之一。

items.title_en: Treasury doubles debt buybacks as Bessent moves to steady bond market
items.title_zh: 随着 Bessent 转向稳定的债券市场，财政部将债务回购增加一倍

items.desc_zh: 该公告针对的是国债市场敏感的长期部分。

items.desc_zh: 据称，该男子是 2022 年在管道上放置炸药的潜水员之一。

items.title_en: Israeli army orders criminal investigation into killing of Palestinian girl Hind Rajab in Gaza

items.desc_zh: 这位 5 岁女孩花了几个小时与医护人员通电话，几天后，她的尸体于 2024 年在加沙城被找到。

items.desc_zh: 目前尚不清楚是什么原因导致两辆车在周三凌晨相撞。

items.desc_zh: 飞机事故调查部告诉英国广播公司，目前尚不清楚机上人员的身份。

items.desc_en: The combination regimen significantly extended the time patients lived without their melanoma returning, compared with Keytruda alone.
items.desc_zh: 与单独使用 Keytruda 相比，联合疗法显着延长了患者黑色素瘤不复发的生存时间。

items.desc_zh: 一名目击者称，米德湖中的骨骼遗骸包括似乎是带有牙齿的人类下巴。

items.title_en: Amazon to expand drone service to nearly 500 cities after targeting 1 million deliveries this year
items.title_zh: 亚马逊今年目标送货量达 100 万次，计划将无人机服务扩展至近 500 个城市

items.desc_zh: 在获得关键监管许可后，亚马逊近几个月已悄然将其无人机服务扩展到更多都市区，从而实现更远距离的送货。
